protocol: settings chosen on 20 validation engines (stages A, B); 5 seeds refit on all 100 training engines for the validated epoch count; test set scored once at each engine's last observed cycle; true RUL capped at 125

search_space.padding: left, copies of the engine's first reading

verdict.rule: deep model wins only if its paired RMSE gap vs XGBoost is significant after Holm AND its near-failure MAE (true RUL <= 50) is not worse than XGBoost's
